title: CrackRebondingControls
description: Frozen configuration for optional crack-face rebonding (v10.2.30). Source of truth: arrhenius_fracture/crack_rebonding_kinetics_v10230.py. Default-off: enabled=false must reproduce baseline physics exactly.

enabled.description: Default-off master switch. No state allocated, no RNG draw, no new floating-point operation inserted into cleavage/emission when false.

contact_model.description: RESOLVED_GAP_TRACTION is a documented future interface; validate() always rejects it in this pass regardless of contact_oracle_* fields, since no oracle contract is implemented.

feedback_mode.description: Only HAZARD_ONLY_REBOND_SHIELD is implemented in this pass; the other two raise NotImplementedError at validate() time.

fresh_surface_clean_fraction.description: P/C/B split assigned to every newly created patch from an accepted event, unconditionally -- independent of initial_precrack_wake_mode.

initial_precrack_wake_mode.description: Governs only whether the pre-existing crack starts with an active wake; never affects newly created patches.

chemistry_factor.description: chemistry_factor=0 gives exactly zero formation hazard without evaluating log(0).

healing_cooperative_order.description: m_h. m_h=1 exactly recovers the elementary rate (mirrors lambda_cleave's own convention).

restored_work_of_separation_J_m2.description: G_rebond_max. Zero gives zero K_rebond regardless of bonded fraction.

minimum_load_hold_s.description: Hard-disabled in this pass: validate() rejects any nonzero value (hold integration is a documented future interface, not implemented).

stochastic_healing_enabled.description: Hard-disabled in this pass: validate() rejects true.

contact_oracle_id.description: Stable identifier for a future resolved-contact oracle binding; never a callable (callables are not JSON-safe/hashable).

rebonding_block_max_dpB.description: Stage 2 exact-verification tolerance on bonded-fraction change per block.

rebonding_block_action_consistency_tol.description: Relative tolerance between the representative-rate action estimate and the exact phase-resolved action over a candidate block.

x-validation-notes: topological_healing_enabled, negative_crack_advance_enabled, crack_segment_deletion_enabled must all be false.
contact_model=RESOLVED_GAP_TRACTION always raises ValueError, even with oracle identifiers supplied.
feedback_mode other than HAZARD_ONLY_REBOND_SHIELD raises NotImplementedError (not ValueError) at validate() time.
All barrier/frequency/activation-volume/tolerance fields are validated non-negative or positive as annotated above; validate() raises ValueError with every violated constraint joined by '; '.
